source: Hero names and Town Hall unlocks are the commonly published values; anything the site could not confirm is marked verified:false.

heroes.name: Barbarian King
heroes.bio: The first hero most Chiefs unlock. He walks into the thick of the fight, soaks up damage and clears a path for the rest of the army.

ability.name: Iron Fist
ability.text: When the ability is triggered the King grows, hits harder and recovers a chunk of health. Save it for the moment he reaches the core.

heroes.name: Archer Queen
heroes.bio: The precision tool of most attacks. She picks off defences from range and her ability buys precious seconds inside a base.

ability.name: Royal Cloak
ability.text: She turns invisible for a few seconds and heals herself, letting her slip past splash defences and finish a core compartment.

heroes.name: Grand Warden
heroes.bio: The only hero who can be set to follow your army. His aura keeps troops alive and his ability can turn a losing push into a three star.

ability.name: Eternal Tome
ability.text: Makes nearby troops and heroes invulnerable for a few seconds — the classic answer to an Eagle Artillery or Monolith shot.

heroes.name: Royal Champion
heroes.bio: A mobile duelist who jumps straight onto defences. She is usually sent in behind the main push to clean up the back end of a base.

ability.name: Seeking Shield
ability.text: Throws her shield at up to four defences, damaging them, and it then returns to her hand.

heroes.notes: Targets, speed and the exact number of shield targets need confirming against the current in-game info panel.

heroes.name: Minion Prince
heroes.bio: An airborne hero who flies over walls and adds constant pressure. He is the natural pick for air armies and for compartments ground heroes cannot reach.

ability.name: Dark Orb
ability.text: Drops a dark orb that damages and slows everything beneath him while he keeps attacking from the air.

heroes.notes: Unlock Town Hall and ability numbers need confirming.

heroes.name: Dragon Duke
heroes.bio: A close-range bruiser who fights with fire. He is built to punch through a compartment and stay there, trading hits with defences.

ability.name: Heart of Fire
ability.text: Ignites his attacks and leaves a trail of flame, damaging everything he walks past.
